notes.text: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code with webserver privileges.
notes.title: Advisory Summary

notes.text: This product is provided subject to this Notification (https://www.cisa.gov/notification) and this Privacy & Use policy (https://www.cisa.gov/privacy-policy).
notes.title: Legal Notice and Terms of Use

notes.text:
CISA recommends users take defensive measures to minimize the risk of exploitation of these vulnerabilities. 
Minimize network exposure for all control system devices and/or systems, ensuring they are not accessible from the internet. 
Locate control system networks and remote devices behind firewalls and isolating them from business networks. 
When remote access is required, use more secure methods, such as virtual private networks (VPNs), recognizing VPNs may have vulnerabilities and should be updated to the most current version available. Also recognize VPN is only as secure as the connected devices.
notes.title: Recommended Practices

notes.text: CISA reminds organizations to perform proper impact analysis and risk assessment prior to deploying defensive measures.
notes.title: Recommended Practices

notes.text: CISA also provides a section for control systems security recommended practices on the ICS webpage on cisa.gov/ics. Several CISA products detailing cyber defense best practices are available for reading and download, including Improving Industrial Control Systems Cybersecurity with Defense-in-Depth Strategies.
notes.title: Recommended Practices

notes.text: CISA encourages organizations to implement recommended cybersecurity strategies for proactive defense of ICS assets.
notes.title: Recommended Practices

notes.text: Additional mitigation guidance and recommended practices are publicly available on the ICS webpage at cisa.gov/ics in the technical information paper, ICS-TIP-12-146-01B--Targeted Cyber Intrusion Detection and Mitigation Strategies.
notes.title: Recommended Practices

notes.text: Organizations observing suspected malicious activity should follow established internal procedures and report findings to CISA for tracking and correlation against other incidents.
notes.title: Recommended Practices

notes.text:
CISA also recommends users take the following measures to protect themselves from social engineering attacks: 
Do not click web links or open attachments in unsolicited email messages. 
Refer to Recognizing and Avoiding Email Scams for more information on avoiding email scams. 
Refer to Avoiding Social Engineering and Phishing Attacks for more information on social engineering attacks.
notes.title: Recommended Practices

notes.text: No known public exploitation specifically targeting these vulnerabilities has been reported to CISA at this time.
notes.title: Recommended Practices

notes.text: A stack-based buffer overflow in an unauthenticated CGI handler of the Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA Series controller allows remote attackers to send specially crafted HTTP/S POST requests, leading to memory corruption, webserver restart and hypothetically potential arbitrary code execution with webserver privileges. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.
notes.title: Vulnerability Summary

notes.text:
Until a software update is available, Danfoss recommends the following mitigations:
* Follow the guidance provided in the product documentation and do not expose devices directly to the Internet or assign them public IP addresses.
* Restrict remote access to affected devices by using a secure VPN or other protected network architecture.
* Configure all affected devices to operate in Strict Mode, which provides enhanced security protections.
* Use strong, unique passwords for all user accounts and administrative access.
* For additional security recommendations and best practices see the Danfoss AK-SM 800 security guidance page: https://www.danfoss.com/en/service-and-support/downloads/dcs/adap-kool-software/ak-sm-800a/#tab-overview
notes.title: Vendor statement from Danfoss

remediations.details: This vulnerability will be addressed in an upcoming Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series software release (version 5.5.x).
In addition, Danfoss will remove the ability for users to disable Strict Mode in future software releases.

vulnerabilities.title: Stack-based buffer overflow in Danfoss AK-SM8xxA unauthenticated CGI handler
